POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Arjun Mehta | Age: 20
Body Temperature at Scene: 27.7°C | Ambient Temperature: 30.5°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 14.9 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  2. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  3. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  4. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  5. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Opiates

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
